::: {#sol-twice-h}

Replacing `f` with `h` and `x` with 4 in the body `(f (f x))` gives `(h (h 4))`.
The [function](#def-function) `h` from @exr-formula-from-code is $h(x) = x^2 - 2x$,
so $h(4) = 16 - 8 = 8$ and $h(8) = 64 - 16 = 48$.
So `(twice h 4)` returns 48.

Racket returns the same value:

```{racket}
#| code-fold: false
(twice h 4)
```

:::
